label: Depth-band spend is summed across nodes, so one node's revisits can close every open sibling in the band with no per-node floor
Growth slots are a single run-wide cap filled in delta order; F-1-002's two proposals filled it at iteration 1 and this node then had no child slots
Cross-lineage duplicate questions are invisible to admission and the merge guard because known-texts and the node store are lineage-local
Depth bands are enforced only in the reducer projection; the node cap is band-blind, so all growth can land at depth 2
Build order for the held rows: 30 plus 12 as one change, then 13 with the adapter capability test, then 29 last
